title: Hot Yoga Studio Directory — Original Hot Yoga Association - OHYA

facts.fact: The OHYA website states that all studios in its Directory meet the association's standards.
facts.quote: All studios in our Directory meet our standards..

facts.fact: The OHYA website says the OHYA Partner Seal identifies OHY classes around the world.
facts.quote: Look for the OHYA Partner Seal to find OHY classes around the world.

facts.fact: The directory's first listing, 105 Fever in Houston, Texas, is labeled "Featured" on the page.
The OHYA directory lists 105 Fever at 2893 S. Braeswood Blvd., Houston, TX 77030, United States.
The OHYA directory lists Be Hot Yoga Atlanta at 730 Ponce deLeon Place, Atlanta, Georgia 30306, United States.
